rule: published artifacts stay byte-identical; corrections are appended
found_by: nan in the driver's own output

entries.old_statement: SOL's CA autocorrelation printed as nan
entries.corrected_statement: CA_s assigns -1 to every index not matching (da > 0) & (db == 0), including indices that are not CA events at all; the mask then selects a sub-series that can be constant, giving a zero denominator and nan. On SOL it did. The SOL CA row is VOID; BTC and ETH rows are unaffected because their masked series are not degenerate, but the construction is fragile and should assign signs only within the mask.
